_comment: Declarative unit-conversion table for wb_card value normalization. The engine (unit_normalizer.py) is generic; ALL units/factors live here. Only EXACT-ratio physical dimensions are listed — no approximate conversions (e.g. months->days) to keep every conversion lossless and unambiguous. To extend: add a dimension or a token with its factor-to-base; no code change needed. factor = how many base units in one of this unit.
